This is unlikely to directly change acute management in a meaningful way.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Changing follow-up from “within 2 days” to “next few days” can delay in-person assessment during an asthma flare, increasing the risk of deterioration before review. While safety-netting to go to A&E if worse mitigates risk, the timing error could still meaningfully affect outcomes.
